// @vitest-environment jsdom
// Drives an OLDER build's real app (this file is copied into that build's tests/ folder) over a
// seeded SEALED save, and writes down what it stored after each step (run with SEALED_OUT=<file>).
// Recorded on v2.26.0 and v2.27.3 (Round 24: builds that never heard of `sealed`) and on v2.28.0 and
// v2.29.0 (Round 26: the READER builds — they load and keep a sealed save, and never start sealing a
// plain one). Two things differ between the two lines, and each is settled here, not by hand:
//   • the chunk ids: SEALED_REAL_IDS=1 names each chunk by the hash of its text, as a sealing save
//     does, which is the only save a reader build can read; without it the ids are the placeholders
//     the Round 24 records were made with (a build that never reads a chunk cannot tell);
//   • the Amnesic switch: a boolean up to v2.27.3, a value ('off' / 'full') from v2.28.0 — told
//     apart by whether the build has store/amnesicMode.
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, within, cleanup, fireEvent, act } from '@testing-library/react'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { App } from '../src/main.jsx'
import { useSettings } from '../src/store/settings.js'
import { useModePrefs } from '../src/store/modePrefs.js'
import { useProgress } from '../src/store/progress.js'
import { rehydrate } from './helpers/persistence.js'
import { createPreset, switchPreset, setPresetAmnesic } from '../src/store/presetControl.js'
import { readDate, correctDayName } from './helpers/modeScreen.jsx'

const DAYS = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday']
function mountApp() {
  const root = document.createElement('div')
  root.id = 'root'
  document.body.appendChild(root)
  return render(<App />)
}
function unmountApp() {
  cleanup()
  document.getElementById('root')?.remove()
}
const isHidden = (el) => {
  for (let n = el; n; n = n.parentElement) if (n.style && n.style.display === 'none') return true
  return false
}
const visibleButton = (name) =>
  screen.getAllByRole('button', { name }).find((b) => !isHidden(b))
const answer = (right) =>
  act(() => {
    const good = correctDayName(readDate())
    const name = right ? good : DAYS.find((d) => d !== good)
    fireEvent.click(visibleButton(name))
  })
const tapStat = (label) =>
  act(() => {
    fireEvent.click(
      screen
        .getAllByRole('button')
        .find(
          (b) =>
            !isHidden(b) &&
            [...b.querySelectorAll('span')].some((s) => s.textContent.trim() === label),
        ),
    )
  })
const tap = (el) =>
  act(() => {
    fireEvent.pointerDown(el)
    fireEvent.click(el, { detail: 1 })
  })

const TAIL = Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => 2 + (i % 50) / 10)
// cyrb53, as store/progressStorage names a chunk by its text.
function chunkId(text) {
  let h1 = 0xdeadbeef
  let h2 = 0x41c6ce57
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text.charCodeAt(i)
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 2654435761)
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ch, 1597334677)
  }
  h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 16), 2246822507)
  h1 ^= Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 13), 3266489909)
  h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 16), 2246822507)
  h2 ^= Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 13), 3266489909)
  return (4294967296 * (2097151 & h2) + (h1 >>> 0)).toString(36)
}
const IDS =
  process.env.SEALED_REAL_IDS === '1'
    ? [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => chunkId(JSON.stringify(TAIL.slice(0, 250))))
    : ['aaa0', 'bbb1', 'ccc2', 'ddd3']
const SEED = {
  state: {
    stats: {
      classic: {
        played: 1400,
        good: 1300,
        streak: 3,
        best: 40,
        times: TAIL,
        timesLost: 1000,
        sealed: { n: 1000, ids: IDS },
      },
      flash: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
      dedDay: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
      dedMonth: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
      dedYear: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
    },
    blitzBest: {},
    suddenBest: {},
    suddenAmBest: {},
    aoxBest: {},
  },
  version: 5,
}

const log = []
const view = (area, key) => {
  const raw = area.getItem(key)
  if (raw === null) return null
  const env = JSON.parse(raw)
  const c = env.state?.stats?.classic
  return {
    version: env.version,
    classic: c && { ...c, times: c.times.length, lastTimes: c.times.slice(-2) },
  }
}
const snap = (step) => {
  const chunkKeys = Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith('cg-times-v1'))
  log.push({
    step,
    main: view(localStorage, 'cg-progress-v1'),
    p2: view(localStorage, 'cg-progress-v1~p2'),
    session: view(sessionStorage, 'cg-progress-v1'),
    chunkKeys: chunkKeys.length,
    dialog: screen.queryAllByRole('dialog').map((d) => d.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? d.textContent.slice(0, 40)),
  })
}

describe('an older build over a sealed save', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    writeFileSync(process.env.SEALED_OUT, JSON.stringify(log, null, 1))
    unmountApp()
  })
  it('drive', async () => {
    localStorage.clear()
    sessionStorage.clear()
    useSettings.getState().resetToFactory()
    useSettings.getState().setRandomFormat(false)
    useSettings.getState().setDateFormat('numeric-ymd')
    useSettings.getState().setMinY(1583)
    useSettings.getState().setMaxY(10000)
    useModePrefs.getState().resetModePrefs()
    useModePrefs.getState().setClassicTimingOff(false)
    localStorage.setItem('cg-progress-v1', JSON.stringify(SEED))
    IDS.forEach((id, j) =>
      localStorage.setItem(`cg-times-v1:classic:${j}.${id}`, JSON.stringify(TAIL.slice(0, 250))),
    )
    snap('seeded')
    await rehydrate(useProgress)
    snap('loaded')
    mountApp()
    snap('mounted')
    answer(true)
    answer(true)
    answer(true)
    snap('3 timed answers')
    answer(false)
    snap('a wrong answer')
    // The wrong answer locked the question; move on if the build wants a tap for that.
    const next = screen.queryAllByRole('button', { name: /^(Next|Continue)/ }).find((b) => !isHidden(b))
    if (next) tap(next)
    answer(true)
    snap('1 more timed answer')
    tap(visibleButton('Override'))
    snap('override in the tail (credit taken back)')
    const undo = screen.queryAllByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).find((b) => !isHidden(b))
    if (undo) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)) // past the double-tap guard
      tap(undo)
      snap('override undone')
    }
    tapStat('Last')
    snap('timing hidden')
    tapStat('Last')
    snap('timing shown again')
    const ask = screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Enable and Reset Stats?' })
    if (ask) {
      const names = within(ask).getAllByRole('button').map((x) => x.textContent)
      log.push({ popupButtons: names })
      const keep = within(ask)
        .getAllByRole('button')
        .find((x) => /Cancel|Keep|No/.test(x.textContent))
      if (keep) tap(keep)
      else act(() => { fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: 'Escape' }) })
      log.push({ popupStillOpen: !!screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Enable and Reset Stats?' }) })
      snap('the false popup was declined')
    }
    const threeWay = await import('../src/store/amnesicMode.js').then(
      () => true,
      () => false,
    )
    act(() => {
      setPresetAmnesic(1, threeWay ? 'full' : true)
    })
    snap('amnesic on')
    answer(true)
    snap('an answer while amnesic')
    act(() => {
      setPresetAmnesic(1, threeWay ? 'off' : false)
    })
    snap('amnesic off')
    let p2
    act(() => {
      p2 = createPreset().id
      localStorage.setItem('cg-settings-v1~p' + p2, localStorage.getItem('cg-settings-v1'))
      switchPreset(p2)
    })
    act(() => {
      useSettings.getState().setRandomFormat(false)
      useSettings.getState().setDateFormat('numeric-ymd')
      useSettings.getState().setMinY(1583)
      useSettings.getState().setMaxY(10000)
    })
    answer(true)
    snap('switched to a new preset and answered')
    act(() => {
      switchPreset(1)
    })
    answer(true)
    snap('switched back and answered')
    unmountApp()
    await rehydrate(useProgress)
    mountApp()
    answer(true)
    snap('reloaded and answered')
    act(() => {
      fireEvent.click(visibleButton('Reset Stats'))
    })
    act(() => {
      fireEvent.click(
        within(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Reset Stats?' })).getByRole('button', {
          name: 'Reset Stats',
        }),
      )
    })
    snap('Reset Stats')
    // The same save with a tail one short of the old 1,000 cap, played past it.
    unmountApp()
    const long = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SEED))
    Object.assign(long.state.stats.classic, {
      played: 1999,
      good: 1999,
      times: Array.from({ length: 999 }, (_, i) => 2 + (i % 50) / 10),
    })
    localStorage.setItem('cg-progress-v1', JSON.stringify(long))
    useModePrefs.getState().setClassicTimingOff(false) // v2.26.0 left timing hidden above
    await rehydrate(useProgress)
    mountApp()
    snap('trim: loaded a 999-time tail')
    answer(true)
    answer(true)
    answer(true)
    snap('trim: 3 timed answers past 1,000')
    writeFileSync(process.env.SEALED_OUT, JSON.stringify(log, null, 1))
    expect(log.length).toBeGreaterThan(10)
  }, 600000)
})
